about: [C12 after the critic] the Tommy gun by the pad, in the gun kit's street (?start=guns.street): R2 held fires the burst and the rumble kicks on its first round and then every third, never continuously; the rumble turned off on the pause card plays nothing, and back on; then L2 (rise over the car) held through a fall and the retry: live at once after the black. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/pad_tommy.json

steps.label: the first press wakes the pad: the bracket only

steps.eval: (window.__s = [], G.on('shot', (e) => { if (e && e.weapon === 'tommy') window.__s.push(+N.pad.t.toFixed(3)); }), window.__f = [], (() => { const f0 = G.fail.bind(G); G.fail = (o) => { window.__f.push(Math.round(N.time) + ':' + (o && o.why)); return f0(o); }; })(), window.__r0 = N.pad.rumbleN, 1)

(() => { const s = window.__s, t0 = s[0] - 0.01, t1 = s[s.length - 1] + 0.1; const k = N.pad.rumbles.filter((r) => r[3] === 70 && r[0] >= t0 && r[0] <= t1).map((r) => r[0]); const gaps = k.slice(1).map((t, i) => +(t - k[i]).toFixed(2)); return { shots: s.length, kicks: k.length, gaps, on: +(k.length * 0.07 / Math.max(0.01, t1 - t0)).toFixed(2) }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const s = window.__s, t0 = s[0] - 0.01, t1 = s[s.length - 1] + 0.1; const k = N.pad.rumbles.filter((r) => r[3] === 70 && r[0] >= t0 && r[0] <= t1); return s.length >= 10 && k.length <= Math.ceil(s.length / 3) && k.length >= Math.floor(s.length / 3) && k.length * 0.07 / (t1 - t0) < 0.35; })()
